first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The low-slung yellow sports car continuously filmed from behind in the foreground, with a dark rear panel, a large dark-red rear wing, and four red ring-shaped taillights.

entities.name: Vehicle B
entities.identification: The low-slung white sports car continuously ahead of Vehicle A, with a dark cockpit area, a rear wing, and red taillights.

entities.name: racetrack surface
entities.identification: The gray paved racetrack surface extending from the foreground and curving to the right.

entities.name: sky
entities.identification: The blue-gray, low-texture sky above the treetops and ridgeline.

entities.name: red-and-white curb
entities.identification: The red-and-white segmented curb laid along the white boundary line at the inner edge of the right-hand bend.

entities.name: green runoff area
entities.identification: The green paved areas at the outer edge of the racetrack and beside the curb on the inside of the bend.

entities.name: concrete racetrack barrier
entities.identification: The continuous low gray wall on the outside of the bend, with some sections colored red and white.

entities.name: racetrack safety fence
entities.identification: The fence above the barrier, supported by repeated tall gray posts.

entities.name: trees around the outside of the racetrack
entities.identification: The dense dark-green trees behind the fence, with treetops of varying heights and shapes.

entities.name: distant mountain
entities.identification: The undulating gray-green mountain and gray mountainside partially exposed behind the treetops.

entities.name: racetrack grandstand
entities.identification: The group of gray grandstands with ascending seating, railings, and support structures.

entities.name: racetrack sign and display screen
entities.identification: The portions visible in this clip are roadside advertising signs and advertising boards along the front of the grandstand, with red text on white backgrounds.

entities.name: roadside grass
entities.identification: The large, low greenish-brown grassy area beside the green paving on the inside of the bend.

entities.name: tall slender pole beside the racetrack
entities.identification: The slender red-gray component extending diagonally toward the upper left from near the orange equipment at its base.

entities.name: group of spectators in the grandstand
entities.identification: The small human figures and patches of dark and light clothing arranged in rows in the grandstand seating, without tracking individuals.
